title: Design System: JPS Painting & Drywall Repair

display.purpose: Hero headline only; uppercase; 15svh term keeps it on a landscape phone's first screen.

title.purpose: h3s in service rows (fluid) and paint chips (1.5rem), uppercase.

lede.purpose: Hero pitch and section ledes, 34-44ch; the closing paragraph runs clamp(17px,4.6vw,20px).

body.purpose: Default copy; row, chip, caption and post text at 16px/1.45-1.5; footer 15px.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked labels: fact terms 14px, brand subline 12px, chip footer 13px, demo tag and Wipe 12px.

headline-close.purpose: The closing h2 only, second clause in wood-ink.

scale.purpose: Every fixed size in use: 12/13/14/15/16/17/18/21px, 1.5rem chip titles, 2.4rem chip numerals. Weights 400/700/800/900.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Fixed paint tools: palette pill, paint tip, hint label.

shadows.name: float-brush
shadows.purpose: Brush button: plaster ring plus float.

shadows.name: float-wall-start
shadows.purpose: Wall mode button over the drywall canvas.

shadows.name: wall-frame
shadows.purpose: Drywall demo frame: the one shadow cast on the navy ground, so it runs deeper than navy-deep.

shadows.name: palette-ring
shadows.purpose: Palette pill: navy ring plus float.

motion.name: ease-paint
motion.purpose: State transitions: button press (.2s), row/callout arrow (.25s), taped photo (.35s), palette and tip (.35s).

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Entrances: swash brush-on (.55s, .5s delay), daub squeeze (.34s), sticky bar enter (.38s), hint, wall caption fade (.28s).

motion.name: ease-exit
motion.purpose: Sticky bar exit, .2s (faster than it enters).

motion.name: daub-stagger
motion.purpose: Palette daubs squeeze out of the brush button.

motion.name: paint-spring
motion.purpose: Shared spring edge for hero band and dividers (CFG).

motion.name: ambient
motion.purpose: Ambient paint wave speed and height.

motion.name: slosh
motion.purpose: Scrolling heaves the band, then it settles.

motion.name: seal-dunk
motion.purpose: Seal surfaces on load and dunks on tap, splashing as it resurfaces.

motion.name: splash
motion.purpose: Droplets flicked off the hero surface.

motion.name: drips
motion.value: DRIPS 4/7, DRIP_MAX 46px; released drops thin to nothing before the edge

motion.name: brush
motion.value: BRUSH 34/26px, BRISTLES 14, LOAD_RUN 1400px; runs while load > .7, max 8
motion.purpose: Paint the page brush and its runs.

motion.name: reduced
motion.value: single still frame at t=2.3; colour/opacity transitions .15s only

photo.purpose: The job photo inside its print border.

fallback-crest.purpose: Vertical radius of the no-JS paint band fallback's wavy top (40% 60% 0 0 / 14px 18px 0 0).

narrative.overview:
The page is wet paint, not a brochure about paint. Its whole palette is lifted from the JPS seal (navy, brush-handle wood, plaster cream) and poured into one can: the hero ends in a living band of marbled paint the visitor can push with a finger, every navy section is joined to the plaster page by a paint edge that drips or rises, and the steps sit on a paint-chip card. The real seal floats in the paint: it surfaces out of it on load, bobs and tilts with the surface, and dunks when tapped. The whole page is a wall the visitor can paint.

It is built for a thumb inside Facebook's in-app browser on cellular: one file, system fonts, no raster except the inlined seal and one of JPS's own job photos, everything sized for a phone first and adapted upward at 560, 720, 900 and 1300px. The voice is plain and heavy: uppercase 900-weight headings in a rounded system face echo the seal's lettering; body copy is short and set large (17px).

Depth comes from paint, not chrome. Grounds alternate plaster and deep navy; the only shadows are soft, navy-tinted and long. There is no black anywhere in the palette.
keyCharacteristics: Two grounds only: plaster (light) and navy-deep (dark), joined by animated paint edges.
Wood is the accent: emphasis words, the 10% off brushstroke, the Facebook callout card, primary buttons on navy.
Heavy uppercase rounded system sans for every heading; tabular numerals for the phone number.
Pill buttons in a primary/secondary pair that share outline and height.
One shared pointer and one rAF loop drive all paint motion; everything springs back.

rules.name: The Never-Black Rule
rules.body: The darkest ground is `navy-deep`. No `#000`, no near-black, no grey grounds. Shadows on plaster are tinted `rgba(19,41,74,…)`; the only deeper value is the shadow cast on the navy ground itself (`rgba(8,20,38,.6)`), still navy.

rules.name: The Wood-Means-Act Rule
rules.body: On navy, the primary action is wood on navy-deep; on plaster it is navy on plaster. Wood as a fill on plaster carries navy-deep text (the 10% brushstroke, the Facebook callout). Wood as text on plaster is `wood-ink`, at headline size only.

rules.name: The Ring-Matches-Ground Rule
rules.body: Focus is a 3px ring offset 3px: navy on plaster, light wood on navy.

rules.name: The Shout-Then-Talk Rule
rules.body: Headings are 900 uppercase with tight leading (≤0.98, 1.05 in the callout); body is never bold-uppercase. Bold (800) inside body is reserved for facts the visitor must catch (bonded & insured, free estimates, 10% off).

rules.name: The Tabular Number Rule
rules.body: The phone number and license always carry `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

rules.name: The Paint-Is-Depth Rule
rules.body: New layering comes from paint over or under an object, not from new shadows or borders.

dos: **Do** reuse the hero paint band, the drip/rise dividers, and their spring behavior exactly on any new page, driven by the same `CFG`, shared pointer, and single loop. Don't fork the simulation per page.
**Do** join every navy section to plaster with a drip (navy above) or rise (navy below) divider filled `navy-deep`.
**Do** keep Call primary and Text secondary, in that order, with pre-filled `sms:` bodies.
**Do** design at phone width first; adapt only at `min-width` 560, 720, 900 and 1300px.
**Do** keep every tap target at least 44px (buttons 52–56px).
**Do** keep a still, non-JS fallback for any new paint surface and a single-frame render under reduced motion.
**Do** keep the footer to facts: name, area, phone, license
donts: **Don't** use black or grey grounds, black text, or black shadows; the darkest value is `navy-deep`.
**Don't** draw thin light highlight lines on paint crests or edges; wet sheen is broad and soft (9px+ strokes at about 10% alpha) or a gradient stop.
**Don't** separate sections with straight edges or rules; the boundary is paint.
**Don't** add a second accent hue or a web font; the palette is the seal's (plus navy-hued material tints) and the type is the system stack.
**Don't** put wood text directly on plaster except `wood-ink` at headline size.
**Don't** add stock photography, icon-card grids, or testimonial carousels; the only images are the seal and JPS's own job photos, taped up as prints.
